info.title: InvestWatch API
info.description:
REST API between the `api` service (owner: C) and the dashboard (owner: B).
Real-time events are delivered over Socket.IO (namespace `/events`), see `schemas/events.schema.json`.
Mock responses for every endpoint are in `mocks/`.

get.description: Sorted by `detected_at` descending unless `sort` is given. Each item includes the derived `risk_level`.

document.title: ScrapedDocument
document.description: A single piece of content collected by the scraper. Stored in the `documents` table (simple columns + JSONB payload). Produced by the scraper, consumed by analytics and the API.

source_id.description: Row in the `sources` table; null for ad-hoc URLs.

source_kind.description: firm_own = published by the investment firm itself (M2); third_party = published by someone else (M1/M3).

lang.description: ISO 639-1 code if known; analytics detects it anyway.

text.description: Clean text of the whole material (no HTML).

content_hash.description: sha256 of the normalized text, for deduplication.

object_key.description: Key in the MinIO bucket `iw-raw`, e.g. media/{document_id}/0.jpg

ocr_text.description: Filled by analytics if OCR is run.

blocks.description: Rendered text blocks from Playwright. Needed only for the visual M2 rules (R4-R8, R13); empty for social media posts.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in CSS pixels relative to the page.

visible.description: Rendered and not hidden by display/visibility/opacity/zero size.

requires_interaction.description: Hidden behind <details>, accordion, tooltip, modal or a link.

overflow_clipped.description: Text is cut off at this viewport.

screenshot_urls.description: API URLs for the screenshots, keyed by viewport

schema.title: Finding
schema.description: Result of one analytics module (M1, M2 or M3) for one document. Stored in the `findings` table, served by the API. `risk_level` is NOT stored - the API derives it from `score` and the current module threshold.

score.description: Raw score; higher = more likely a violation.

risk_level.description: Present only in API responses: high >= threshold, medium >= threshold - 0.2, otherwise low.

firm.description: Investment firm the material concerns (M1, M2).

advertiser.description: Party publishing or offering the content (M1, M3).

on_warning_list.description: Entity appears on the KNF public warnings list.

rules.description: M2: results of the 18 UKNF rules (R1-R18); M1/M3: signals (S1.x / S3.x).

rule_id.description: R1-R18 (incl. R12a/R12b) for M2, S1.x for M1, S3.x for M3.

result.description: For M1/M3 signals: fail = signal detected (suspicious).

evidence.description: Exact quote from the document (verified substring).

get.summary: Number of findings over time per module
Precision/recall curve for the threshold slider
get.description: Computed from analyst labels (confirmed / false_positive) and the gold set.

put.summary: Update thresholds (recomputes risk_level for all findings)

schema.title: Source
schema.description: A place the scraper collects content from. Stored in the `sources` table; managed by the scraper, editable from the dashboard.

url.description: Start URL, profile URL or search query URL.

schedule_cron.description: Cron expression, e.g. '0 */6 * * *'; null = manual only.

patch.summary: Edit a source (e.g. toggle active, change schedule)

post.summary: Trigger a manual scan of a source
post.description: Pushes a message to Redis Stream `iw:scan-requests`. Progress arrives as `scan.started` / `scan.finished` events.

get.summary: Status of the API and its dependencies
